# Tiferes — Sidebar Cascade Critique

The Awtsmoos joins restraint with revelation until neither steals the other's place;
Awtsmoos.com needs one cascade whose authority can be understood by reading its face.

## Safeguards

1. Preserve every existing public class and ID consumed by JavaScript.
2. Do not change markup unless CSS evidence proves it necessary.
3. Keep every active selector under `.post-reader-localized-context`.
4. Never use unscoped `#custom-context-menu` or `#insane-verse-menu`.
5. Never use unscoped `.sidebar` in active reader styles.
6. Eliminate `z-index:2147483647` and `2147483000`.
7. Use the local token ladder for sidebar, popover, and modal surfaces.
8. Use `dvi` rather than component `vw` sizing.
9. Never hide mobile UI using `left:-9999px`.
10. Never hide mobile UI using `translate(-120vw)` or `translate(-140vw)`.
11. Never use negative z-index as a visibility mechanism.
12. One hidden-sidebar rule owns mobile absence.
13. One open-sidebar rule owns mobile bounded geometry.
14. One desktop rule owns edge-docked geometry.
15. Keep safe-area insets in all fixed mobile surfaces.
16. Keep sidebar internal content independently scrollable.
17. Avoid body/document overflow changes from sidebar styles.
18. Preserve reduced-motion users from unnecessary transform transitions.
19. Hover states apply only when hover is supported.
20. Focus-visible must remain obvious even without hover.
21. Active states must not cause layout shift.
22. Disabled controls must communicate disabled interaction.
23. Breadcrumb links retain wrapping and touch sizing.
24. Chrome controls retain minimum touch target sizing.
25. Fullscreen mode must suppress competing floating controls.
26. Fullscreen uses `100dvi`/`100dvh`, not `100vw`.
27. Context action sheets remain inside safe horizontal and vertical viewport bounds.
28. Context menu items receive hover, active, focus-visible, and disabled states.
29. Keep reader-beauty decorative only; no global layout ownership.
30. Split every touched stylesheet beyond 120 lines by responsibility.
31. Do not shorten comments to satisfy the line limit.
32. Do not compress selector blocks to satisfy the line limit.
33. Preserve the current successful desktop/mobile reader geometry contract.
34. Run selector-ownership tests after the rewrite.
35. Run the 13-reader contract universe after the rewrite.
36. Re-run cache-disabled BrowserHarness after all CSS changes.
37. Treat any document overflow above 1px as a failure.
38. Treat any sidebar/settings surface outside viewport bounds as a failure.
39. Verify the hidden sidebar cannot receive pointer events.
40. Record dead historical sidebar styles separately instead of deleting them without import proof.
